notes.title: The new free bonus level available!
notes.content:
Dozens of enemy tanks, robots and mutants are attacking your Mars bases!
A new additional mission added, the aim of which is to break through the defenses and destroy the mutant nuclear power plant. The power plant is an important strategic goal and its destruction is necessary to regain control of Mars.

New bonus missions are published periodically.

notes.title: New bonus level and changes in the equipment shop added.
notes.content: New levels are available outside of the main mission. They can be played independently of the other levels. New levels for single-player and multiplayer game will be added periodically.
